Finding: App/backend version mismatch blocks v2 screens
Expected behavior: Compatible requests and actionable update handling
Observed behavior: Unmodified app omits X-App-Version. Server assumes 1.0.0 and requires 2.0.0; app config is 1.0.1. Native Manager cards, Driver crew/help and Owner captures show raw 426.
Reproduction: Log in as audit Manager -> Home; Driver -> More -> Crew/Driver help; Owner -> Capture reviews.
Next work: Agree release version/contract compatibility, send truthful build version and add an update-required state. A header alone with 1.0.1 still fails.

Finding: Owner review uses the Driver capture endpoint
Expected behavior: Owner queue calls /app/v2/captures/review
Observed behavior: Frontend calls /app/v2/captures?page=1. It gets 426 first; diagnostic version 2.0.0 gets 403 for OWNER. Correct /captures/review returns 200.
Reproduction: Owner -> More -> Capture reviews.
Next work: Use the owner review endpoint and its response schema/pagination; then exercise review decisions.

Finding: Crew URLs, payload and response shapes disagree
Expected behavior: Use /crew, /crew/:vehicleId, /crew/:vehicleId/actions and declared schemas
Observed behavior: App uses /crew/me and /crew/vehicles/:id; diagnostic calls give 400/404. expectedVersion and safelyStopped are rejected as extra fields. Detail API returns nested crew/atWheel unlike flat screen assumptions.
Reproduction: Driver -> More -> Crew & driving; compare correct diagnostic detail in API evidence.
Next work: Align helpers and screen adapters to mounted contracts, then test join/at-wheel/handover/history.

Finding: Duty response fails its own contract with real intervals
Expected behavior: Duty interval evidence dates serialised as strings/null
Observed behavior: Diagnostic 2.0.0 GET /app/v2/duty/today returns 500: evidence.counted[0].start must be string or null. Crew/at-wheel fixtures use real models/services. App first encounters version 426; no normal Rest entry.
Reproduction: Use seeded Driver token and X-App-Version:2.0.0 to GET duty/today.
Next work: Serialise Date evidence before response validation; verify populated duty and empty states.
Original screenshot: No direct UI screenshot: API/source-only evidence

Finding: Help response fails contract for alert dates
Expected behavior: Help cards raisedAt serialised as strings/null
Observed behavior: Diagnostic 2.0.0 GET /app/v2/help returns 500: cards[0].raisedAt must be string or null. Native screen shows 426 before reaching this defect.
Reproduction: Driver -> More -> Driver help; diagnostic API request with version 2.0.0.
Next work: Normalise Date fields before response validation and retest real alert cards.

Finding: Field Agent organisation selector crashes on load
Expected behavior: Loading state handles null data and then lists memberships
Observed behavior: Native Orgs tab renders Cannot read property length of null. useApi initially returns data:null; FieldAgentOrgsScreen reads orgs.length before guarding it.
Reproduction: Use multi-org agent@... -> Orgs. Backend /me/orgs returns two active memberships.
Next work: Guard initial/error data as an array and retest first load, retry and org switching.

Finding: Field Agent server logout is not revoked
Expected behavior: Logout retains required org context until server session is revoked
Observed behavior: Native POST /app/v1/auth/logout returns 400: X-Org-Id header is required for Field Agents. Local identity is cleared; server revocation fails. Dev console error can obscure the next login.
Reproduction: Field Agent -> Profile -> Log out.
Next work: Pass captured active org into revokeAppSession; preserve local sign-out if network revocation fails.

Finding: Chosen truck is dropped by the fuel form
Expected behavior: AUD20NOV01 selected in picker remains selected in form
Observed behavior: Picker passes vehicleId/vehicleNumber to FuelCapture. Registered FuelLogFormScreen ignores route params and initialises vehicleId empty; native form shows Vehicle:Choose.
Reproduction: Single-org agent.primary@... -> Upload fuel receipt -> Select AUD20NOV01.
Next work: Initialise and validate the chosen truck against current-org options; load its driver and previous reading.

Finding: Fuel log makes hard-coded period/trend claims
Expected behavior: Month and trend reflect loaded records or unknown
Observed behavior: Native log shows August and Improving in November, including an empty organisation with no mileage data. Source literals confirm this is not computed.
Reproduction: Field Agent -> Fuel; inspect empty-org log screenshot.
Next work: Use actual date/filter and measured trend, or show unknown when no usable history.

Finding: Navigate and driving journey are not implemented
Expected behavior: Planned map/search/preview/guidance/offline states
Observed behavior: Driver Navigate is an unavailable page. Backend navigation, destinations, routes and ahead contracts do not produce an active frontend journey.
Reproduction: Driver default Navigate tab.
Next work: Complete Phase 2 frontend and custom native/device integration; keep separate from Phase 1 release acceptance.

Finding: Wallet, reimbursement and advances are inactive
Expected behavior: Accessible wallet/bills/ledger/advance flows
Observed behavior: Older components and backend bills/advance services exist, but active Driver shell has no Wallet/Add bill/My advances route. Advance-request action is not connected.
Reproduction: Inspect Driver More and Capture menus; compare route inventory with original design.
Next work: Decide retained scope; connect required flows and test balances, rejection, resubmission and payouts.

Finding: Manager action details do not implement planned actions
Expected behavior: Call/outcome, handled, snooze, escalate and feedback UI
Observed behavior: Backend supports card actions, but current detail screen renders evidence rather than complete action controls; Home also blocked by I01.
Reproduction: Inspect ManagerActions.js ActionDetail and registered routes; Home runtime is blocked.
Next work: Wire actions and idempotent outcomes to contracts after version integration.

Finding: Registered services lack normal menu paths
Expected behavior: Driver can reach consent, rest, road/site/question workflows
Observed behavior: Routes exist but primary More/Capture menus do not expose privacy consent, Rest & hours, Road report, Site card, reminders and Helpful cards. Stop reasons sits behind secondary Quick add, absent from primary Capture.
Reproduction: Review visible Driver More/Capture entries and active route inventory.
Next work: Add intentional entries/triggers and retest actual entry, permission and save flows.

Finding: Owner promise, trip-cost closure and declaration-policy screens absent
Expected behavior: Owner can set promise, inspect cost closure, declare crew/policy
Observed behavior: Corresponding backend readers/services exist; current Owner branch lacks the planned screens/forms. Crew & driving is vehicle crew, not owner declarations/policy.
Reproduction: Compare Owner menu and branch routes with master/owner plans.
Next work: Implement accepted frontend scope then test revisions, validation and persistence.

Finding: Legacy report entry has no visible exit
Expected behavior: A report opened from More has a back control
Observed behavior: More -> Today's business report opens a full report with no visible back button and no bottom tab bar. Browser tour cannot return via the normal header. iOS edge-back escape was not verified.
Reproduction: Owner -> More -> Today's business report.
Next work: Render a back control for this stack route or route to the Today tab; test iOS and web.

Finding: Data saver, simple mode and survey preferences missing
Expected behavior: Requested controls and actual behavioral effects
Observed behavior: Language/voice settings contains three language buttons, voice test and battery help only. No active controls for data saver, simple mode or survey preference.
Reproduction: More -> Language & voice / Experience settings.
Next work: Define and implement preference storage plus corresponding behavior before marking complete.

Finding: Manager branch daily report absent
Expected behavior: Branch manager can open planned branch report
Observed behavior: No Manager report screen; Owner daily API returns 403 to Manager by current role rule. This is expected API enforcement but missing planned capability.
Reproduction: Use Manager token GET /app/v2/reports/daily; inspect Manager menu.
Next work: Agree Manager-specific scope/contract and implement report UI. Do not simply remove Owner authorisation.

Finding: Capture read scope declaration differs from org-wide implementation
Expected behavior: Explicit agreement whether captures are driver-self or shared within org
Observed behavior: With diagnostic version 2.0.0, Driver 1 reads own and co-driver capture metadata (both 200). Contracts declare scope.driver:self while descriptions/use case read org-wide. Cross-org list remains isolated.
Reproduction: GET seeded capture0 and capture1 with Driver 1; compare declared scope and API descriptions.
Next work: Resolve ownership policy; if self is intended, enforce it in list/by-id. This audit does not call it a confirmed cross-tenant leak.
Original screenshot: No direct UI screenshot: API/source-only evidence

Finding: Report delivery/audience/provider settings incomplete
Expected behavior: Email/WhatsApp controls, delivery history and complete audiences
Observed behavior: Current UI saves enabled/time/language/branch. Email/WhatsApp settings, provider delivery history and full audience controls are absent/partial; external sending not tested.
Reproduction: Owner -> Morning report; compare delivery-history API and menu.
Next work: Complete accepted settings and outcome UI, then test delivery on approved external test channels.

Finding: Required idempotency headers missing on v2 writes
Expected behavior: Retry-safe writes carry stable Idempotency-Key
Observed behavior: Client has no Idempotency-Key handling for consent/crew/capture/prompt APIs. Consent POST returns 400 without it even though its min version is 1.0.0; correct crew action also returns 400 without it with diagnostic version.
Reproduction: Run logged postchecks or invoke the currently unreachable consent action from its source path.
Next work: Create and persist a stable header key per submission, handle conflicts and retest retries without duplicate writes.
